ranked.headline: Oncology models import external references and other modalities to improve prediction
ranked.summary: New preprints link bulk, single-cell, cfDNA and histology data through external references, as in mFrag, DeSCENT, OmniT2I and KLONE.

ranked.headline: Disentangled models predict perturbation responses while OT couples multimodal dynamics
ranked.summary: Several new perturbation predictors and optimal-transport or multimodal frameworks target counterfactual responses and coupled chromatin–expression dynamics.

ranked.headline: Generative models shift from single structures to conformational ensembles and transitions
ranked.summary: All-atom generative frameworks, cross-state allosteric prediction and physics-grounded energetics are pushing structure modeling past static single-pose outputs.

ranked.headline: Deep models reconstruct 3D tissue and infer missing omics layers from sparse spatial data
ranked.summary: New methods (HIM-INR, THiRST, ORBIS) lift spatial transcriptomics into 3D, while MorphoProt, CORAL and DIRAC infer or align molecular layers.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell methods add significance tests and explicit artifact models
ranked.summary: New preprints test whether clusters and spatial domains are real and separate spillover, ambient RNA and doublets from genuine cell state.

ranked.headline: Learned tokenizers encode modality-specific symmetries in compact biomolecular models
ranked.summary: Brieno and MirrorDNA learn discrete tokenizers for nanopore signal and DNA, while benchmark audits in Protify and RPFace stress generalization over leakage-prone evaluation.

ranked.headline: Microbial genomic data are mined and modeled to characterize function, interactions and metabolism
ranked.summary: Metagenome-derived Cas9 mining, essential-gene interaction maps and kinetic-parameter metabolic models point to scaling functional inference across microbial genomes.

ranked.headline: Curated enzyme and regulatory databases add quantitative records, structural context and API access
ranked.summary: Four database updates extend curated quantitative data on enzyme stability, kinetics and yeast transcription regulation, with new access and curation frameworks.

ranked.headline: Learned models rank enzyme, reaction and mutant candidates, with benchmarks and wet-lab checks
ranked.summary: New enzyme-ranking models are paired with campaign-grouped benchmarks, reaction-disjoint tests and experimental validation, tightening how prioritization is assessed.

ranked.headline: Donor-aware statistical models extract disease and genetic signal beyond mean gene expression
ranked.summary: New methods model donor-level variance, isoform diversity, and cell-type-specific genetics to resolve disease-associated expression in large single-cell and spatial cohorts.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold-based structure predictions are being stress-tested and applied to design and annotation
ranked.summary: New studies test AlphaFold models against membrane geometry, amyloid polymorphism and binder design, while pipelines annotate pathogen proteomes.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks compare DIA search, quantitation and postprocessing choices on spike-in and real samples
ranked.summary: Five papers dated 2026-11-06 benchmark DIA search tools, quantitation utilities and postprocessing across spike-in, plasma and cardiovascular datasets.

ranked.headline: Binding and function predictors are judged under harder splits, where data properties outweigh architecture
ranked.summary: Binding and function predictors increasingly report generalization under stricter evaluation, with dataset properties often outweighing encoder choice.

ranked.headline: Integrated omics databases map regulatory, perturbation and GWAS signals to cell- and isoform-level contexts
ranked.summary: Nov 2026 releases extend transcriptome resources toward cell-type, isoform and perturbation resolution, with cancer lncRNA and perturbation atlases among them.

ranked.headline: Integrated gut microbiome and host-disease databases consolidate samples and multi-layer omics
ranked.summary: New NAR database releases pool 168 464 gut microbiome samples and host-microbe data across 15 gut-related diseases into reusable public resources.

ranked.headline: Explicit latent-process models replace naive assumptions in microbial and viral genomic inference
ranked.summary: New methods model hidden rates, sampling zeros and reverse mutations explicitly to improve inference from bacterial, microbial and pathogen genomic data.

ranked.headline: Mechanics, membrane, and matrix coupled in single frameworks for migration, invasion, and tissue degradation
ranked.summary: Three new models couple cell mechanics to ECM, nuclear, or inflammatory processes, spanning analytical bounds, surface PDEs, and finite element simulation.

ranked.headline: Auditable evaluation and reliability controls for ML and agents in biomedical prediction
ranked.summary: Agent benchmarks, cold-start leakage checklists and conflict-aware affinity models converge on making biomedical ML claims auditable and generalizable.

ranked.headline: Archives and browsers update data access, annotation transfer and streaming for large public datasets
ranked.summary: Concurrent NAR database updates from BioImage Archive, UCSC and ENA extend access to imaging and sequence data and their annotations.

ranked.headline: Compact structure-derived surrogates approximate fluctuations and molecular properties at lower cost
ranked.summary: A C-alpha B-factor model cuts factorization from O(N^3) to O(Nk^3), alongside ML surrogates for solubility, Mössbauer and retention index prediction.

ranked.headline: Global metrics and plate design confound single-cell perturbation response evaluation
ranked.summary: Foundation-model perturbation predictors are being audited for whether reported gains survive delta-based and design-aware evaluation.

ranked.headline: Proteoform-aware DIA, phosphosite FLR, and glycoproteomics data standards
ranked.summary: Recent releases extend proteomics beyond peptide identification into proteoforms, phosphosite localization, and glycoproteomics data sharing.

ranked.headline: Correcting bias and testing reproducibility before interpreting genetic associations
ranked.summary: Recent work applies selection-bias correction, survival pseudo-observations, and replicability testing to association data.

ranked.headline: Germline-aware pangenome references reframe somatic variant discovery
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and new long-read callers show graph and personalized pangenomes improving somatic variant detection relative to GRCh38.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell interaction and developmental dynamics from single-cell snapshots
ranked.summary: Time-resolved single-cell and spatial transcriptomics now support learning interaction and developmental dynamics from unmatched snapshots and trajectories.

ranked.headline: Stochastic models of growth, division and expression are fitted to noisy data
ranked.summary: Noisy single-cell and microbiome time series now demand likelihood methods that handle latent stochastic dynamics and irregular sampling.

ranked.headline: Computational tools resolve isoforms, splicing and polyadenylation from RNA-seq data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and database papers add computational methods for splicing, polyadenylation and intronic transcript structure from RNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: LLM agents now drive drug discovery, robotic protocols, and autonomous DNA labs
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM systems are now reaching physical execution in biology, alongside red-teaming of their biosynthesis planning risks.

ranked.headline: Single-cell frameworks benchmark maturation and heterogeneity in organoid models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair organoid and single-cell datasets with benchmarking, segmentation and curation tools aimed at reproducible, standardized analysis.

ranked.headline: Constrained molecular generation and screening meet filtering and experimental checks
ranked.summary: Constrained generative and screening models are now paired with filtering and experimental checks on predicted hits in 2026 publications.

ranked.headline: New algorithms scale species tree inference and exact rooted tree partitioning
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study target scale and exactness in species tree, lineage, and genomic distance inference.

ranked.headline: Predictive models are re-scored against exposure, resistance and transporter outcomes
ranked.summary: Generative and predictive drug models are increasingly tested against PBPK exposure, measured resistance and transporter risk endpoints.

ranked.headline: Panel-level reference frameworks reconcile plant genome diversity across assemblies
ranked.summary: Multi-accession wheat and cereal panels now demand consistent annotation of repeats, genes, and sequence diversity across assemblies.

ranked.headline: Polymer models infer hidden chromatin rules from Hi-C and epigenomic data
ranked.summary: Hi-C-trained and epigenome-informed polymer models now infer chromosome ensembles and locus dynamics directly from contact and epigenomic data.

ranked.headline: Dynamics-aware tests reveal static structure metrics overstate protein model fidelity
ranked.summary: MD-based evaluation of motif scaffolds and cofolding benchmarks show static predictions can overstate dynamical and conformational accuracy.

ranked.headline: LLMs mine literature for chemical-effect and hepatotoxicity evidence
ranked.summary: Automated LLM pipelines now convert full-text toxicology and biomedical literature into structured, queryable evidence for AOP and hepatotoxicity work.

ranked.headline: Recovering coding content from sequence evidence beyond reference annotation
ranked.summary: Proteogenomic and comparative genomics studies are recovering coding content and flagging annotation artifacts directly from sequence evidence.

ranked.headline: E/I circuit models link cell-type structure to recovery and dynamical regimes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply E/I circuit, mean-field, and surrogate-accelerated models to recovery dynamics and regime control in cortex.

ranked.headline: Connectome-constrained models: wiring claims hinge on controlled physiology and audits
ranked.summary: Connectome-derived models are now tested under fault injection, operation audits, and fair physiology tuning to probe structure-function claims.

ranked.headline: Search-space constraints and benchmarks for peptide identification in MS proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent proteomics tools benchmark glycopeptide validation and PTM combination scoring while reducing viral search databases by 82-95%.
